$comment: Hacking Growth — anti-pattern perilaku user pada akuisisi/retensi.

anti_patterns.name: Shiny Channel Hopping
anti_patterns.symptom: Pindah-pindah channel (iklan, konten, marketplace, tiktok) tiap beberapa minggu tanpa pernah mengukur satu channel sampai bisa disimpulkan.

anti_patterns.name: Acquisition Before Retention
anti_patterns.symptom: Increasing ad/outreach volume even though many new customers don’t return — filling a leaky bucket.

anti_patterns.name: Feelings-Driven Iteration
anti_patterns.symptom: Mengubah penawaran/harga/channel berdasarkan selera atau komentar satu orang — tanpa pembanding sebelum-sesudah.
